reason: I'd use the free visit on a Saturday and probably pay for one drop-in if my kid liked it, since indoor options here are limited. We'd go once or twice a month at most, so the membership doesn't make sense for us.
objection: We only have weekends free, so a $39-45 membership would sit unused most months. I'd also want to see how clean it actually is in person before paying.
would_change_my_mind: Weekend-only pricing or a pack that doesn't expire, and a first visit that confirms it's clean and not overcrowded on Saturdays.
